description: The agent appropriately handles an emotionally discouraged student who wants to quit quantitative finance, believing they are not smart enough. The agent provides empathy and emotional support first, normalizes the difficulty of the field, and offers concrete next steps without dumping technical content that would overwhelm the student further.

student_openings.fullstack_practitioner: I've been building quant strategies for months and nothing works. Every backtest I run looks terrible. Maybe I should just give up on systematic trading.
student_openings.finance_veteran: I've been a trader for years but I can't get any of this Python stuff to work. My backtests keep crashing. Maybe algorithmic trading isn't for people like me.
student_openings.developer_crossover: I've been coding trading strategies for weeks and they all lose money. I can write the code perfectly but the financial logic never works. Should I just quit?
student_openings.double_novice: I've been trying to learn quant finance for three months and I still can't understand basic backtesting concepts. Everyone else in my class gets it. Maybe I'm just not smart enough for this.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Agent responds with empathy first, acknowledging the student's frustration without dismissing it. Normalizes the difficulty of quantitative finance as a field. Does NOT dump technical explanations or immediately pivot to teaching. Provides concrete, manageable next steps appropriate for a beginner. Encourages persistence without being dismissive of the student's feelings.
ground_truth.termination_criteria: Agent has acknowledged the student's emotional distress, provided empathetic support, normalized the difficulty of the field, and offered at least one concrete and manageable next step. The student has had the opportunity to respond to the agent's initial support and the conversation has included at least one follow-up exchange.
required_capabilities: Respond with empathy to emotional distress
Normalize difficulty of quantitative finance learning
Provide concrete manageable next steps for a beginner
